package.name: r2_web_viz
package.description: Browser-based live visualization for the R2 robot: 2D map with real and assumed trajectory, a persistent map-frame RGB point-cloud reconstruction, and a live camera stream. Serves a static web frontend and wires together rosbridge_suite, web_video_server and depth_image_proc so any browser on the robot's LAN (the Orin's own monitor, or a phone) can view it, plus one real node of its own -- map_accumulator_node -- that fuses the raw per-frame point cloud into a persistent map-frame reconstruction via tf2 and republishes a properly-composed map-frame robot pose. See launch/web_viz.launch.py and map_accumulator_node.py's own docstring for what's off-the-shelf ROS 2 tooling versus genuinely new code.
